hebrewText: הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה

tokens.bdb: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
tokens.kjv: (make) boast (self), celebrate, commend, (deal, make), fool(-ish, -ly), glory, give (light), be (make, feign self) mad (against), give in marriage, (sing, be worthy of) praise, rage, renowned, shine.

tokens.bdb: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
tokens.kjv: consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, ([idiom] most) holy ([idiom] day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanation: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanationEn: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract

tokens.bdb: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
tokens.kjv: cheer up, be (make) glad, (have, make) joy(-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to) rejoice, [idiom] very.

tokens.bdb: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
tokens.kjv: [phrase] care for, comfortably, consent, [idiom] considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart(-ed), [idiom] heed, [idiom] I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), [idiom] regard(-ed), [idiom] themselves, [idiom] unawares, understanding, [idiom] well, willingly, wisdom.
tokens.enLiteralWord: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings
tokens.explanation: lev — coração, mente, vontade, centro da vida interior
tokens.explanationEn: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings

tokens.bdb: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
tokens.kjv: ask, beg, beseech, desire, enquire, get, make inquisition, procure, (make) request, require, seek (for).

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"
